description: Defines the InputDispatcherInterface class, an interface for handling input events in the Android system, including methods for event injection, focus management, input channels, and system state queries.

classes.name: InputDispatcherInterface
classes.description: An interface class for dispatching input events and managing input system state in Android.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the state of the input dispatcher.

methods.name: monitor
methods.description: Checks that the dispatcher has not deadlocked.

methods.name: waitForIdle
methods.description: Waits until the dispatcher is idle.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts processing input events.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops processing input events.

methods.name: injectInputEvent
methods.description: Injects an input event into the system, optionally waiting for sync.

methods.name: verifyInputEvent
methods.description: Verifies whether an input event actually occurred.

methods.name: setInputWindows
methods.description: Sets the list of input windows per display.

methods.name: setFocusedApplication
methods.description: Sets the focused application for a display.

methods.name: setFocusedDisplay
methods.description: Sets the focused display.

methods.name: setInputDispatchMode
methods.description: Enables or disables input dispatching mode.

methods.name: setInputFilterEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables input event filtering.

methods.name: setInTouchMode
methods.description: Sets the touch mode state for a display.

methods.name: setMaximumObscuringOpacityForTouch
methods.description: Sets maximum obscuring opacity for touch propagation.

methods.name: transferTouchFocus
methods.description: Transfers touch focus between windows.

methods.name: transferTouch
methods.description: Transfers touch focus to a specific channel.

methods.name: setFocusedWindow
methods.description: Sets focus on a specific window.

methods.name: createInputChannel
methods.description: Creates a new input channel.

methods.name: createInputMonitor
methods.description: Creates an input monitor for a display.

methods.name: removeInputChannel
methods.description: Removes an input channel.

methods.name: pilferPointers
methods.description: Steals the current pointer stream from input windows.

methods.name: requestPointerCapture
methods.description: Enables or disables pointer capture on a window.

methods.name: setDisplayEligibilityForPointerCapture
methods.description: Sets display eligibility for pointer capture.

methods.name: flushSensor
methods.description: Flushes input device motion sensor data.

methods.name: displayRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a display.

methods.name: cancelCurrentTouch
methods.description: Aborts the current touch stream.

methods.name: requestRefreshConfiguration
methods.description: Requests an update to the input system configuration.
